title: Biblical Overlap Routing — Waves 11–12
purpose: Route the new Son-side and Tim/Father-side deepening research without bloating the older waves or duplicating owner responsibilities.

cross_wave_epiphanies.chain: Farmers kill beloved Son outside vineyard → rejected Stone/Cornerstone → Father/Gardener tends living vine → Davidic House establishes Father/Son/Throne
cross_wave_epiphanies.meaning: The strongest new synthesis is architectural rather than titular: death/rejection on the Son side becomes House/Garden/stewardship on the Father side.

cross_wave_epiphanies.chain: Genesis ladder/gate → John 1 Son of Man as ascent/descent locus → project Son Door / Father Ladder split
cross_wave_epiphanies.meaning: Biblical material sometimes collapses Door and Ladder functions onto the Son, so project roles should be represented as relational emphases rather than airtight equivalences.

cross_wave_epiphanies.chain: Dan judges → serpent in path → waits for salvation → lion cub
cross_wave_epiphanies.meaning: Biblical serpent and lion imagery can coexist within one tribe. This is a strong warning against treating every serpent symbol in the project as automatically satanic.

cross_wave_epiphanies.chain: God builds House → Son over House → people are House → field/building → Key of House → Father to inhabitants
cross_wave_epiphanies.meaning: House is not one object: source, structure, lineage, community, access system and stewardship can all be distinct relations.

timeline_policy: Only the September 9 research unlocks enter the timeline automatically. Earlier project-side dates remain in their existing timeline owners and receive later-parallel links there rather than duplicated cards.
